description: Sends a six-digit verification code to a phone number by SMS and returns the code, so you can compare it with what the user types. The message reads `123-456 is your verification code. Don't share.` The request is charged the message's cost in credits (`cost`), which depends on the destination country and carrier; a message that would cost more than 10,000 credits is not sent (`max_cost_exceeded`). Failed requests are not charged. Group: Verification. Billing per call: Credits: metered (~332.16 avg).

target.description: The phone number in international format, with its country calling code, for example `+1 201 555 0123`. Spaces and dashes are allowed; a missing `+` is added.

name: post_send_numeric_verify
title: Send Verify SMS
